name: Supplying the Front
label: Quest
description: Ironforge sends smiths to help supply the Mountaineers in Loch Modan. Tormus Deepforge asks apprentices to forge weapons and armor for the defenders…

clips.title: The story
paras: Ironforge sends smiths to help supply the Mountaineers in Loch Modan. Tormus Deepforge asks apprentices to forge weapons and armor for the defenders facing trogg attacks.

Tormus Deepforge watches Khaz Modan’s borders from the forges of Ironforge. The Mountaineers in Loch Modan face sudden trogg attacks from ruins and caverns opened by excavation. Their defensive lines need fresh blades, belts, and fittings, so local smiths help keep them supplied.

Tormus sends apprentices east to Loch Modan so veteran smiths can stay at the city forges. His colleague Thorvald Deepforge keeps a field armory in the southern guard tower. Bringing Thorvald sturdy copper axes and copper chain belts helps prove a smith’s reliability and earns advanced smithing techniques.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The mountaineers of Loch Modan are fighting troggs, and having a busy time of it! They need constant supplies of new armor and weapons if we're ever to get a handle on those troggs.

That's why my colleague Thorvald is there, trying to keep the mountaineers in good gear. So if you were to make some copper axes and copper chain belts and bring them to Thorvald, he would be obliged. He might even share his knowledge with you.
Thorvald is in Loch Modan's southern guard tower.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have no time to chat. Do you have business with me?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, apologies! I didn't realize you were here to help resupply our troops. The stuff you made will be a big help!
Here are plans for some armor. I hope you find them useful.
